Name: Cushi, Messenger of Joab
Summary: Cushi is identified only by this name when Joab sent him to tell David of Absalom's death. He ran after Ahimaaz, delivered the news plainly, and answered David's question about Absalom with the words that broke the king's heart.
KeyStory: Cushi, known only by his name, carried the news of Absalom's death to David.
RelatedPeople: King David; Ahimaaz, Son of Zadok; Joab
LifeLesson: The bearer of the hardest news deserves to be remembered for telling it straight.
